description_en: You can call the RemoveSharesFromExpressSync operation to delete multiple shares from an express synchronization group
description_zh: 调用RemoveSharesFromExpressSync可以删除极速同步组对应的共享。可删除多个共享
name: RemoveSharesFromExpressSync

parameters.description_en: The ID of the express synchronization group.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the express synchronization group
parameters.name: express_sync_id

parameters.description_en:
The names of the gateway shares. You can delete multiple shares. The JSON format is:

- {"Gateway ID 1":"Share 1,Share 2","Gateway ID 2":"Share 1,Share 2"}
parameters.description_zh:
网关共享名称。可以删除多个共享，JSON格式为：

- {"网关ID1":"共享1，共享2","网关ID2":"共享1，共享2"}
parameters.help_en:
The names of the gateway shares. You can delete multiple shares. The JSON format is:

parameters.name: gateway_shares
